purpose: Anonymized coding of saved Revvy public review export and recent internal negative chat sample; no API access.

source_files.type: public Google and Yandex reviews export
internal chat history referenced by helper plan; one chat, 17 messages

public_corpus.same_platform_possible_duplicate_caution: Two identical short Yandex texts “Не вкусно” on 2025-07-05 and 2025-08-31 were counted as one text opinion for theme frequencies; distinct people cannot be confirmed.

date_quality.note: 79 Google records carry Jan 1 timestamps (44 in 2022, 6 in 2023, 15 in 2024, 14 in 2025); these dates do not support precise timing/trend comparisons.

last_90_days_from_2026_10_11.notes: Hard-issue cases are public rows 1, 5, 9, 17; rows 3/4 are one cross-post describing slow delivery as understood/planned around, not a complaint. Row 17 is rated 5 but contains an explicit order-accuracy error and recovery. Independent source check: public row 1 says the order had not arrived after 3 hours at review time; it does not establish final non-delivery/cancellation.

mixed_or_qualified_notes: Final delivery/cancellation status unknown; absence stated after 3 hours.

public_corpus.historical_manual_coding_scope: All public reviews rated 1-4 were manually coded for complaint themes; this is not a full semantic coding of all 259 texts. Selected mixed 5-star cases are included as notes, and the 90-day period was reviewed across all ratings.

internal_corpus.coded_issue_details: The matching chat contributes one issue, repeated in two client messages: rice fell apart and could not be eaten with chopsticks; the client still described the taste positively. Do not count the repeated messages as separate complaints. A separate brief “not very good lately” message has no theme. Most of the 16 snapshots are numeric rating selections; rating 4 remains negative under current threshold but does not guarantee substantive complaint text.
internal_corpus.history_deduplication: The chat history matches one of the 16 snapshot chats by date and content; it is not a seventeenth independent chat.
internal_corpus.message_date_note: The linked history spans Feb 9 to Sep 18, 2026. It is historical context, not a 30-day complaint event set.

positive_themes.observed_in_reviews: Taste/food quality; freshness and ingredient quality; delivery speed/on-time arrival; polite/helpful staff; value, bonuses and promotions; gifts; menu choice/variety; convenient app/site; meals for family and occasions; customers naming repeat choice or recommendation.
positive_themes.note: Positive marker counts use rating-5, nonempty text and broad phrase matching; language was spot-checked. They are mentions in public review texts, not customers or orders; mixed feedback can appear under rating 5.

limitations: Public reviews are self-selected and cannot diagnose why non-reviewers reduced or stopped ordering.
Google dates are mostly Jan 1 placeholders; year/time trends and recency there are unreliable.
Public review counts are review texts/platform appearances, not unique customers; no identity linkage between Google, Yandex, Revvy chats, WhatsApp, or orders was attempted.
The internal negative category is filtered by Revvy settings and includes rating 4; score/category is not equivalent to substantive complaint text.
Do not add public and internal counts: windows, units and selection mechanisms differ.

order_nonreceipt_report records customer-reported non-receipt or failure to fulfil; final order status is not established by that label. Public row 1 states non-receipt after three hours at review time.
